Adani Group Announces Rs 2.6 Trillion Projects in Maharashtra

Pranav Adani announced that the Adani Group has projects worth Rs 2.6 trillion completed or underway in Maharashtra. This statement was made at the 'Invest Maharashtra' launch event in Mumbai, where Adani stated, 'When Maharashtra Wins, India Wins.'
